comment: Every canvas baseline, newest first. The first entry must match the committed canvas-baseline.png and the pngSha256 in canvas-baseline.json. tests/tooling/canvas-baseline.test.mjs enforces that, so a baseline cannot change without someone writing down why.

baselines.reason: The capture now finishes CSS transitions before the shot. Selecting a card starts a .16s inspector slide and a .12s handle fade, and no wait in the scene waited for either, so earlier baselines could be taken mid-transition. The inspector and the selected card's handle therefore sit at their end state in this image. Verified across eight consecutive runs and three build configurations.

Superseded. First baseline with the build version and store path served as constants, so the toolbar reads `baseline` rather than a commit SHA and a temporary directory. It agreed across two captures and was still caught later by the animation race, which two samples cannot detect.

Superseded. The first capture of the dense scene. It predates the version stub, so its toolbar carries a real build, and it predates the Labels filter button, which added a toolbar control and pushed the card count and relationship selector onto a second row.
